earliest_safe_boundary: Before capture persistence as accepted evidence or inclusion in a baseline cohort; validate incoming bytes before deriving aggregate statistics.
requirements: Strict parse rejects duplicate keys and nonfinite values
Exactly one declared source representation binds observation digest; if both producer and source_snapshot contain capture facts, identities agree
Recompute canonical source digest and compare exact commit/tree/clock identity
Authenticate retained stdout/stderr hashes when declared; missing bytes or hashes remain incomplete
Recompute timing through existing pipeline_timing_observation and validate existing observation schema
Never promote timing shape validation into custody authentication or performance certification
Reject malformed/inconsistent captures without altering originals or starting provider work
Rejection evidence identifies cause and source artifact without authorizing outcome reconstruction
required_controls: legacy capture missing authentication fields remains unqualified
recovery: Preserve rejected originals and any separately authenticated producer bytes. Create a new explicitly linked capture only from independently recoverable originals; never infer missing bytes or silently repair provenance.
activation: Production guard and tests remain pending under peer hold; this specification conveys no execution or lifecycle authority.
